trials.name: Efficacy and Safety of CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic in Adults With Androgenetic Alopecia
trials.officialTitle: A 24-Week, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Randomized Human Application Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic in Adults With Androgenetic Alopecia

design.interventionModelDescription: Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to one of three parallel groups: a low-concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic group, a high-concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic group, or a vehicle control group without the active ingredient. Each participant received the assigned product once every 2 weeks for 24 weeks.

maskingInfo.maskingDescription: Participants and investigators were masked to product assignment. Products were assigned according to a pre-generated randomization schedule, and masking was maintained until completion of the study. Product identities were disclosed by the sponsor after the study was completed.

eligibility.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female adults aged 18 to 54 years with androgenetic alopecia diagnosed according to at least one of the following applicable classification systems:
* Basic and Specific classification: basic type M1 or higher, C1 or higher, or U1 or higher, together with specific type V1 or higher or F1 or higher
* Norwood-Hamilton classification: stage II or higher for male participants
* Ludwig classification: stage I or higher for female participants
* Participants willing to avoid special hair products, hair treatments, and other manipulation of the hair during the study period
* Participants willing to maintain the same hairstyle and hair color as at the first study visit throughout the study period
* Participants who understood the purpose of the study and voluntarily provided written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Serious acute renal or cardiac disease, or another chronic disease such as hypertension or diabetes, within the previous 6 months that could affect the study results
* Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or plans to become pregnant within 6 months
* Psychiatric disease
* Infectious skin disease
* Previous surgical treatment for hair loss, including hair transplantation or scalp reduction surgery
* Use of oral dutasteride or finasteride within the previous 6 months
* Use of topical hair growth products, hair tonics, or other products intended to promote hair growth within the previous month
* Use within the previous month of steroids, cytotoxic agents, vasodilators, antihypertensive agents, anticonvulsants, beta-blockers, bronchodilators, diuretics, spironolactone, cimetidine, diazoxide, cyclosporine, or ketoconazole
* Use of a topical corticosteroid on the scalp within the previous month
* Severe seborrheic dermatitis, scalp psoriasis, scalp infection, or another scalp condition considered likely to interfere with application of the study product
* A hair loss disorder other than androgenetic alopecia, including alopecia areata, telogen effluvium, or scarring alopecia
* Nutritional deficiency caused by excessive dietary restriction, gastrectomy, or another condition, or use of nutritional supplements that could affect hair loss
* Any other condition considered by the principal investigator to make the individual unsuitable for study participation

arms.label: Low-Concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic
arms.description: Participants assigned to this arm received the low-concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic applied topically to the scalp by study personnel once every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, for a total of 12 applications.
interventionNames: Other: Low-Concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic

arms.label: High-Concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic
arms.description: Participants assigned to this arm received the high-concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic applied topically to the scalp by study personnel once every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, for a total of 12 applications.
interventionNames: Other: High-Concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic

arms.label: Vehicle Control
arms.description: Participants assigned to this arm received the vehicle control product formulated without CosmeRNA-AR. The control product was applied topically to the scalp by study personnel once every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, for a total of 12 applications.
interventionNames: Other: Vehicle Control Tonic Without CosmeRNA-AR

interventions.name: Low-Concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic
interventions.description: A transparent liquid cosmetic scalp formulation containing CosmeRNA-AR at the lower concentration evaluated in this study. The product was applied topically to the scalp by study personnel once every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, for a total of 12 applications.

interventions.name: High-Concentration CosmeRNA-ARI Anti Hair Loss Tonic
interventions.description: A transparent liquid cosmetic scalp formulation containing CosmeRNA-AR at the higher concentration evaluated in this study. The product was applied topically to the scalp by study personnel once every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, for a total of 12 applications.

interventions.name: Vehicle Control Tonic Without CosmeRNA-AR
interventions.description: A transparent liquid cosmetic scalp formulation without CosmeRNA-AR. The control product was applied using the same method and schedule as the investigational products: once every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, for a total of 12 applications.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Hair Density
primaryOutcomes.description: Hair density was measured as the number of hairs per square centimeter in a designated scalp area using Folliscope 5.0. The same marked scalp area was assessed at baseline and after 8, 16, and 24 weeks of product use. Changes from baseline were compared among the low-concentration investigational product, high-concentration investigational product, and vehicle control groups.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to Week 8, Baseline to Week 16, and Baseline to Week 24

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Hair Thickness
primaryOutcomes.description: Hair thickness was measured in millimeters using Folliscope 5.0. Three hairs within the designated scalp assessment area were selected for analysis. The same marked scalp area was assessed at baseline and after 8, 16, and 24 weeks of product use. Higher values indicated thicker hair. Changes from baseline were compared among the three study groups.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to Week 8, Baseline to Week 16, and Baseline to Week 24

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Hair Growth Rate
primaryOutcomes.description: Hair growth rate was measured in millimeters per day using Folliscope 5.0. Three hairs within the designated scalp assessment area were selected for analysis. At baseline and after 8, 16, and 24 weeks of product use, paired images were obtained 2 days apart to calculate the daily hair growth rate. Higher values indicated faster hair growth. Changes from baseline were compared among the three study groups.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to Week 8, Baseline to Week 16, and Baseline to Week 24

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Expert Global Assessment of Hair Growth
secondaryOutcomes.description: Standardized photographs of the vertex and frontal hairline were independently evaluated by two experts using a 7-point global photographic assessment scale ranging from -3, indicating markedly worse, to +3, indicating markedly improved; 0 indicated no change from baseline. If the two experts assigned different scores, the lower score was used for analysis. Inter-rater reliability was evaluated using the intraclass correlation coefficient. Scores were compared among the low-concentration investigational product, high-concentration investigational product, and vehicle control groups.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participant-Reported Evaluation of Changes in Hair Loss Symptoms
secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants evaluated perceived changes in overall hair loss symptoms, hair fullness at the vertex, the amount of shed hair, and the frontal hairline using a 7-point scale ranging from -3, indicating markedly worse, to +3, indicating markedly improved; 0 indicated no change. Responses of +1 to +3 were classified as positive responses. Results were summarized as the percentage of participants providing a positive response to each item.

trials.name: Effects of CosmeRNA Brow Revitalizing Serum on Eyebrow Density and Length
trials.officialTitle: A Human Application Study to Evaluate the Effects of CosmeRNA Brow Revitalizing Serum on Eyebrow Density and Length

design.interventionModelDescription: All participants received both interventions concurrently in a within-participant, split-face design. The investigational product was applied to one eyebrow and the control product to the contralateral eyebrow for 8 weeks.

eligibility.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy Korean adults aged 20 years or older
* Individuals who received sufficient information about the purpose and procedures of the study and voluntarily signed the informed consent form
* Individuals without acute or chronic physical illnesses, including skin diseases
* Individuals able to participate in follow-up assessments throughout the study period

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals who were pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant
* Individuals with a psychiatric disorder or an infectious skin disease
* Individuals who had used a topical corticosteroid for the treatment of a skin disease for 1 month or longer
* Individuals who had participated in the same study within the previous 6 months
* Individuals with sensitive or hypersensitive skin
* Individuals with abnormal skin findings at the assessment area, including moles, acne, erythema, or telangiectasia
* Individuals who had used cosmetics, medications, or other products with the same or similar claimed effects on the assessment area within the previous 3 months
* Individuals who had received dermatologic or cosmetic procedures on the assessment area within the previous 6 months, including liposuction, laser treatment, ultrasound-assisted fat reduction, or other skin care procedures
* Employees of the study institution
* Individuals considered unsuitable for study participation by the principal investigator

arms.label: Investigational Product-Treated Eyebrow
arms.description: CosmeRNA Brow Revitalizing Serum containing SDS-DNA-2/RNA-6 was applied to the assigned eyebrow once daily for 8 weeks.

arms.label: Control Product-Treated Eyebrow
arms.description: The control serum formulated without SDS-DNA-2/RNA-6 was applied to the assigned eyebrow once daily for 8 weeks.
interventionNames: Other: Control eyebrow serum without SDS-DNA-2/RNA-6

interventions.name: Eyebrow serum containing SDS-DNA-2/RNA-6
interventions.description: A transparent, viscous cosmetic serum containing SDS-DNA-2/RNA-6. Participants applied an appropriate amount to the assigned eyebrow once daily, in the morning or evening, for 8 weeks. After application, the eyebrow area was gently massaged using the silicone applicator tip and lightly patted to aid absorption.

interventions.name: Control eyebrow serum without SDS-DNA-2/RNA-6
interventions.description: A transparent, viscous control cosmetic serum formulated without SDS-DNA-2/RNA-6. Participants applied an appropriate amount to the assigned eyebrow once daily, in the morning or evening, for 8 weeks, using the same application procedure as for the investigational serum.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Eyebrow Density
primaryOutcomes.description: Eyebrow density was measured as the total number of eyebrow hairs per square centimeter using phototrichogram images obtained with Folliscope 5.0. Changes from baseline were evaluated for the eyebrow treated with the investigational serum and the contralateral eyebrow treated with the control serum.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to Week 4 and Baseline to Week 8

primaryOutcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in Eyebrow Hair Length
primaryOutcomes.description: Eyebrow hair length was measured in pixels using Image-Pro 10 software applied to images obtained with Folliscope 5.0. Changes from baseline were evaluated for the eyebrow treated with the investigational serum and the contralateral eyebrow treated with the control serum.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to Week 4 and Baseline to Week 8

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Participant-Reported Evaluation of the Investigational Serum
secondaryOutcomes.description: Participants evaluated their experience with the investigational serum using a 6-point questionnaire, where 1 indicated "strongly disagree" and 6 indicated "strongly agree." Responses of 4 to 6 were classified as positive responses. Results were summarized as the percentage of participants providing a positive response to each questionnaire item.

Skin adverse reactions were assessed throughout the study based on participant reports and physical examination by a dermatologist. The outcome was summarized as the number of participants with any skin adverse reaction during product use.
